import os
import openpyxl
from openpyxl.styles import PatternFill
from openpyxl.formatting.rule import FormulaRule

input_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/CF_7349/1_CF_7349_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/CF_7349_0_958c5871/1_CF_7349_output.xlsx"

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

# Target range: D2:Q16
min_row, max_row = 2, 16
min_col, max_col = 4, 17

green_fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor="C6EFCE")
red_fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor="FFC7CE")
no_fill = PatternFill(fill_type=None)

# Build Cat1 lookup by (Code, Name), per month column
cat1_rows = {}
for r in range(min_row, max_row + 1):
    code = ws.cell(r, 1).value
    name = ws.cell(r, 2).value
    flag = ws.cell(r, 3).value
    if flag == "Cat1":
        cat1_rows[(code, name)] = r

# Apply literal fills to Cat2 cells in D2:Q16 according to the specified logic
for r in range(min_row, max_row + 1):
    code = ws.cell(r, 1).value
    name = ws.cell(r, 2).value
    flag = ws.cell(r, 3).value

    for c in range(min_col, max_col + 1):
        cell = ws.cell(r, c)
        cell.fill = no_fill

        if flag != "Cat2":
            continue

        cat1_row = cat1_rows.get((code, name))
        cat1_value = ws.cell(cat1_row, c).value if cat1_row else None
        cat2_value = cell.value

        cat1_blank = cat1_value is None or cat1_value == ""
        cat2_blank = cat2_value is None or cat2_value == ""

        if cat1_blank:
            cell.fill = green_fill
        elif not cat1_blank and cat2_blank:
            cell.fill = red_fill

# Also add conditional formatting rules over D2:Q16 so the logic remains active in Excel
target_range = "D2:Q16"

green_rule = FormulaRule(
    formula=[
        '=AND($C2="Cat2",SUMIFS(D$2:D$16,$A$2:$A$16,$A2,$B$2:$B$16,$B2,$C$2:$C$16,"Cat1")=0)'
    ],
    fill=green_fill
)

red_rule = FormulaRule(
    formula=[
        '=AND($C2="Cat2",D2="",SUMIFS(D$2:D$16,$A$2:$A$16,$A2,$B$2:$B$16,$B2,$C$2:$C$16,"Cat1")>0)'
    ],
    fill=red_fill
)

ws.conditional_formatting.add(target_range, green_rule)
ws.conditional_formatting.add(target_range, red_rule)

wb.save(output_path)
